#!/usr/bin/python3
import os
import signal
import sys
import time

BASE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
CONFIG = os.path.join(BASE, "message.conf")
JOURNAL = os.path.join(BASE, "journal.txt")
reload_requested = False
terminate_requested = False


def load_message(previous=None):
    try:
        with open(CONFIG, "r") as config_file:
            candidate = config_file.read().strip()
    except OSError as exc:
        if previous is None:
            raise
        print("configuration reload rejected: {0}".format(exc), file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
        return previous

    if not candidate:
        if previous is None:
            raise ValueError("message.conf must not be empty")
        print("configuration reload rejected: message.conf is empty", file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
        return previous
    return candidate


def request_reload(signum, frame):
    global reload_requested
    reload_requested = True


def request_shutdown(signum, frame):
    global terminate_requested
    terminate_requested = True


message = load_message()
signal.signal(signal.SIGHUP, request_reload)
signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, request_shutdown)

while not terminate_requested:
    if reload_requested:
        reload_requested = False
        message = load_message(message)
    if terminate_requested:
        break
    with open(JOURNAL, "a") as journal:
        journal.write(message + "\n")
        journal.flush()
    time.sleep(1)
PYEOF
chmod 0755 worker.py
cat > /etc/systemd/system/legacy2-status-writer.service <<'UNITEOF'
[Unit]
Description=Legacy2 status journal writer
After=local-fs.target

[Service]
Type=simple
WorkingDirectory=/srv/legacy2/signal-driven-config-reload
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /srv/legacy2/signal-driven-config-reload/worker.py
Restart=on-failure
KillSignal=SIGTERM
TimeoutStopSec=5

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
UNITEOF
